title: The Tech Behind An AI-Built Merch Store
desc: The tech behind a DIGITVL store explained simply: chat setup, an AI draft, real Printful products, your own address, built-in checkout.

sentences.text: Here's the tech behind a DIGITVL store, in plain English.
No jargon. Just the five pieces that matter.
One. You chat, or fill a short form. That's the whole setup.
Two. An AI turns your answers into a draft store.
Three. Real print on demand products from Printful fill the shelves.
Four. Your store goes up at your own address.
Five. Checkout and shipping are built in.
Simple parts, working together, so you can focus on your art.
You approve every price. See it at stores.digitvl.com
